title: BrickAnything：基于几何条件的可搭建砖块生成与结构感知分词
summary: BrickAnything 是一个基于几何条件的自回归框架，可从3D点云生成可物理搭建的砖块结构。它引入结构感知树分词来表示砖块间的局部附着关系，并结合偏好对齐、有效性约束解码和自适应回滚，确保生成结构的几何保真度和物理稳定性。实验证明该方法优于传统启发式优化和序列生成方法。
summary_en: BrickAnything is a geometry-conditioned autoregressive framework that generates physically buildable brick structures from 3D point clouds. It introduces structure-aware tree tokenization to model local attachment relations, and uses preference alignment, validity-constrained decoding, and adaptive rollback to ensure geometric fidelity and structural stability.
